messages:
pagerbot: PD alert fired for service=inference-gateway region=eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=5% current=12% -> paging SRE oncall
sre-oncall: Oncall acked. i'm taking it. starting quick triage.
emma: seeing the same in logs, spike started ~1736543100. traffic from lb-eu-2 is highest.
kyle: tagging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx (follow canary rollback section) :eyes:
sre-oncall: good. first check: recent deploys? canary 2026-03-17T01:12Z rolled 30m ago.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary 2026-03-17T01:12Z -> image inference:v1.9.3 (10% weight)
charlie: can we temporarily cut canary weight to 0? might confirm rollback hypothesis.
sre-oncall: doing that now. command: 
```kubectl patch vs inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"traffic":{"canaryWeight":0}}}'```
ops-bot: traffic-slice update accepted. canary weight -> 0% (propagating)
emma: metrics updating, 5xx dropping to 7.8% in the last 30s. still above threshold but trending down.
kyle: if that keeps falling we can hold. if it rebounds we should fail the deploy and flip to previous. prepping rollback steps.
sre-oncall: checking proxy logs for KV cache errors. grep snippet: 
```403 | kv-proxy | err=timeout reading upstream
502 | inference | upstream reset
```
charlie: we've had a couple of transient upstream resets from model-pool-eu3 in the same window. opening connection to infra to confirm (pinging infra eng).
sre-oncall: notifying customers team for visibility: @emma can you flag customer impact for top 5 enterprise tenants? include timeframe and example request IDs.
emma: will do. drafted message to support with sample request-ids: req_abc123, req_def456, req_ghi789. ETA 5m.
ops-bot: autoscaler activity: no recent scale events. GPU pool utilization steady at 68%.
sre-oncall: ok trend looks like canary caused the spike. i'm going to promote mitigation: keep canary at 0, monitor for 10m, if 5xx < 3% for 5m we'll close PD. if it rebounds we rollback full canary and open a full incident.
kyle: copy. i have rollback command ready.
charlie: infra confirmed intermittent tcp resets from model-pool-eu3 node 7 — investigating network flaps.
emma: customer comms sent to support and account reps. noting degraded for EU customers between 01:12-01:36 UTC.
sre-oncall: 10m check: 5xx now 2.1%. continuing to observe. leaving note in incident tracker.
pagerbot: PD event resolved (status=resolved) by sre-oncall (ack and mitigation applied)
emma: marking impacted customers list in tracker. will reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
kyle: postmortem owner? assigning charlie to coordinate write-up with deploy/infra details.
charlie: acknowledged. will collect logs, canary bundle, and infra network traces. target draft in 24h.
sre-oncall: thanks team. handing off to follow-up ops. closing thread unless anyone sees fresh alerts.
emma: thanks all :heart:
